# Optavius

> Optavius builds AI voice agents for specialty care practices: ophthalmology, optometry, dermatology and veterinary. The agent answers every patient call, books and moves appointments, gives order status and escalates urgent symptoms by the practice's own protocol. Pricing follows results, starting from $299 per month. Offices in Houston and Amsterdam. Site in English, Dutch and German.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://www.optavius.com/product): the voice agent, every channel, trust and safety
- [Console](https://www.optavius.com/product/console): morning brief, every call and booking, plain-language commands
- [Ask Optavius](https://www.optavius.com/product/ask-optavius): free answers over the practice's own data for 90 days
- [Agents](https://www.optavius.com/product/agents): front desk, booking, order status, recall, no-show recovery and more
- [Integrations](https://www.optavius.com/product/integrations): phone systems, calendars, EHR and practice management systems
- [Pricing](https://www.optavius.com/pricing): outcome-based pricing, no results no cost
